checked: winner agrees with Wikipedia's list of by-elections; Robert Dillon Browne's 599 from the Statesman, 9 May 1836, p. 4 (Walker prints 609); John Denis Browne's 305 agrees
correctionNote: Robert Dillon Browne's poll set to 599 (research-J OT19, owner-approved 13 Nov 2026): the Statesman and Dublin Christian Record of 9 May 1836, p. 4, reprinting the Mayo Constitution's state of the poll at the close, prints R. D. Browne 599 and John Browne 305, majority 294 (599 - 305 = 294); Stooks Smith (1842), as Wikipedia cites it, also gives 599, and 599 + 305 = 904 is the turnout Wikipedia gives on 1,491 electors. Walker prints 609, which no contemporary print supports.
